mapper.select: select from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_set_definition d left join lateral (select * from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_set_version x where x.factor_set_definition_id=d.id order by x.version_no desc limit 1) v on true where d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and d.owner_id=#{ownerId} and d.factor_set_code=#{code} and d.deleted_at is null

select from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_set_definition d left join lateral (select * from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_set_version x where x.factor_set_definition_id=d.id order by x.version_no desc limit 1) v on true where d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and d.owner_id=#{ownerId} and d.deleted_at is null order by d.updated_at desc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_set_definition set name=#{d.name},version=version+1,updated_at=now() where id=#{d.id} and tenant_id=#{d.tenantId} and owner_id=#{d.ownerId} and version=#{expectedVersion} and deleted_at is null
mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_set_version(id,factor_set_definition_id,version_no,source_study_id,expression,validation_snapshot,status) values(#{v.versionId},#{definitionId},#{v.versionNo},#{v.sourceStudyId},cast(#{v.expression} as jsonb),cast(#{v.validationSnapshot} as jsonb),#{v.versionStatus})
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_set_version set status=#{status},validation_snapshot=cast(#{snapshot} as jsonb) where factor_set_definition_id=#{definitionId} and version_no=#{versionNo} and status in ('DRAFT','VALIDATED')

update cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_set_definition set active_version_id=#{versionId},status='ACTIVE',version=version+1,updated_at=now() where id=#{definitionId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and deleted_at is null
